LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 1.1.1 LISTENING FOR INFORMATION

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.1: Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information, part of Strand 1 in Grade 7 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How should we listen for specific information from a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to readings of texts or recorded audio clips in a group and respond to questions,

2. take notes from oral texts or audio clip texts,

3. share notes with peers in class for peer review,

4. work collaboratively to make a list of new vocabulary from the listened-to texts,

5. construct simple sentences using the new vocabulary from the texts,

6. team up to prepare a creative mosaic of a typical indigenous home design,

7. display their mosaic designs during class exhibitions and festivals.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to readings of texts or recorded audio clips in a group and respond to questions,
2. take notes from oral texts or audio clip texts,
3. share notes with peers in class for peer review,
4. work collaboratively to make a list of new vocabulary from the listened-to texts,
5. construct simple sentences using the new vocabulary from the texts,
6. team up to prepare a creative mosaic of a typical indigenous home design,
7. display their mosaic designs during class exhibitions and festivals.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Listening for information together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: This is developed as the learner listens to readings of texts or recorded audio clips

actively and responds to questions.

• Digital literacy: This is enhanced as the learner accesses content when listening to recorded audio clips and responding

to questions.

Values:
• Respect: This is achieved as the learner accepts the contributions of peers when they share notes in class for peer

review.

• Unity: This is enhanced as the learner collaborates with peers to make a list of vocabulary learnt from the listened to

texts.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Cultural awareness is enhanced as the learner interacts with information on different indigenous homes.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can employ listening for information skills to other language learning areas such as Kiswahili and English
